scenario: LIC premium renewal reminder - outbound agent call
source: synthetic (macOS `say`, Indian English voices Rishi + Tara)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning sir, this is Anbarasan calling from LIC. Am I speaking with Mr Kumar?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sir, this is a reminder about your LIC policy. Your premium of four thousand five hundred rupees is due on the twentieth of October.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, I completely forgot about it. Is there any grace period?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes sir, you have thirty days grace period. But if you pay before the due date you will avoid the late fee.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, how do I pay? Can I pay it online?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, you can pay through the LIC portal, or I can send you a payment link on WhatsApp.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Please send the link on WhatsApp. I will pay it this evening.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Sure sir, I will send it within five minutes. Thank you for your time.

expected_summary: Agent Anbarasan called Mr Kumar to remind him that his LIC premium of Rs 4,500 is due on 20 October. The customer had forgotten and asked about the grace period; the agent explained it is 30 days but paying before the due date avoids a late fee. The customer agreed to pay this evening and asked for a payment link on WhatsApp, which the agent promised within five minutes. Outcome: promise to pay, follow-up required.
